notes.title: Beta Version 0.3
notes.notes:
The latest version of the beta is now live.
Patch notes:[list]
[*]Revised the introduction based on game adjustments.
[*]Game is now endless until it is completed, as long as you pay your weekly rent.
[*]Weekly rent of 100 is now required every sunday.
[*]Option for a late payment with a fee is now included if not paid on Sunday.
[*]Main Street on the map is now accessible, with access to the Real Estate Office to pay rent if you miss the payment.
[*]Bad ending has been added if rent remains unpaid by the following Friday.
[*]New Events have been added to the Work.
[*]Extra Rias chats now occur when working.
[*]Working milestones now lead to pay increases.
[*]Once you have worked 15 times, the amount you have worked will not increase, until the 15th special event is completed. It is currently half finished.
[*]Exhaustion effects have now been added to the game, if you have less than 0 energy when you go to bed, this negative effect will take place.
[*]Exhaustion will lead to you losing a day.
[*]Housing Estate on the map is now accessible, with option to return home, ending the day.
[*]Placeholder options added to Back Alley on the map.
[*]Placeholder options added to Pier on the map.
[*]Placeholder options added to Resort on the map.
[*]Placeholder options added to Train Station on the map.
[*]Placeholder options added to Town Square on the map.
[*]Placeholder options added to Side Streets on the map.
[*]Placeholder options added to Shops on the map.
[*]Placeholder options added to Park on the map.
[*]Placeholder options added to Housing Estate on the map.
[*]A variety of new variables added to the game.
[/list]
